info.name: Weavr Multi Product BackOffice Access Token Transaction Activity API

params.name: offset
params.description: The offset value for paging, indicating the initial item number to be returned from the data set satisfying the given criteria. Leave out to fetch the first page of results.

params.name: limit
params.description: The limit of the results for paging, starting at the offset. Limit is always capped at 100.

params.name: type
params.description: Filter by one or more transaction activity types.

params.name: status
params.description: Filter by one or more normalised transaction statuses.

params.name: direction
params.description: Filter by transaction direction (CREDIT or DEBIT).

params.name: creationTimestampFrom
params.description: Filter for transactions created after this timestamp. Epoch timestamp using millisecond precision.

params.name: creationTimestampTo
params.description: Filter for transactions created before this timestamp. Epoch timestamp using millisecond precision.

params.name: lastUpdatedTimestampFrom
params.description: Filter for transactions last updated after this timestamp. Useful for pulling recently changed transactions. Epoch timestamp using millisecond precision.

params.name: lastUpdatedTimestampTo
params.description: Filter for transactions last updated before this timestamp. Epoch timestamp using millisecond precision.

params.name: sortOrder
params.description:
Sort order for the results:
  - ASC: Ascending order, oldest first.
  - DESC: Descending order, most recent first.

params.name: sortBy
params.description: The field to sort transaction activity results by. Defaults to `creationTimestamp`.

items.docs:
Returns all transactional activity across all managed accounts and managed cards.

This provides a single view of all transfers, sends, wire transfers, card payments, fees, and other
transaction types regardless of which wallet they belong to.

`creationTimestamp` is when the transaction was created in its owning service (the same value the
nested `transaction` object reports), and is the field the creation-window filter applies to.
